title: LocalServices agent analysis output
description: Shared validation schema for service candidates grounded in the analyzed directory. Analysis only. Optional fields may be omitted (including cmd for Compose components). The Codex adapter prepares a strict output schema from this definition.

source_dir.description: Directory holding this service, relative to the analyzed directory. Use '.' for the analyzed directory itself.

open.description: Main entry URL to open in a browser, if the service has a web UI

cmd.description: argv array (local components only; required unless run="compose"). Prefer real executables/scripts (make targets: ['make','<target>']). No shell strings.

run.description: local = LocalServices-launched process (cmd required). compose = managed via docker compose (no cmd; compose_service required). Default local.

compose_service.description: run=compose: service name inside the compose project (required for compose components)

compose_project.description: run=compose: compose project name (default: cwd directory name)

compose_files.description: run=compose: compose file paths relative to source_dir (no ..); default auto-detect in cwd

provision.description: run=compose: existing = only start existing containers; up = may create/pull via compose up -d --no-deps, requires service.confirmed_provision=true (user authorization)

shell_script.description: Only if the project's own script genuinely requires a shell: path of an existing script inside the directory

http.description: GET URL that answers 2xx/3xx when the component is ready

tcp.description: host:port that accepts connections when ready

external_cmd.description: Regex matching this component's process command line, to recognise instances started outside LocalServices

container.description: Existing docker container name this dependency maps to, if any

resource_refs.description: Existing docker/compose resources this service reuses, as 'container:<name>'

confirmed_provision.description: Explicit user authorization for provision=up compose components (container creation/pull). The analysis phase must never assume it; leave it out/null unless the user explicitly confirmed.

summary.description: Why this definition starts the project: entry points, ports, readiness, data locations

files.description: Concrete files/lines the definition is grounded in, e.g. 'Makefile:179 sources-manager'

unresolved.description: Questions only the user can answer; each blocks a field you left out (e.g. required environment variables)
